description: This PHP class 'Setting' in the Opencart project handles retrieval of store settings from the database. It provides methods to fetch all settings, specific settings by code, and individual setting values based on keys.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing store settings within the Opencart framework, providing methods to retrieve settings data from the database.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves all settings for a specified store ID from the database.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves settings data associated with a specific code and store ID, decoding serialized data if necessary.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value of a specific setting key for a given store ID.
